texts.value: Pore-forming subunit of Ca(2+) homeostasis modulator channels. Mediates ATP release from astrocytes and ATP-induced Ca(2+) influx in microglia thus regulating neuronal ATP and Ca(2+) homeostasis, synaptic transmission and neuroinflammatory response. May form intercellular gap junctions. The gating mechanism remains unknown
Inhibited by Ca(2+) and ruthenium red in a voltage-dependent way
Homo-undecamer. Two undecameric hemichannels can assemble in a head-to-head manner to form a gap junction
It remains controversial whether CALHM2 forms functional homomeric channels

features.description: Markedly reduces the inhibition by ruthenium red. Does not affect Ca(2+)-dependent inactivation of the channel.
Markedly reduces the inhibition by ruthenium red at negative membrane potentials. Does not affect Ca(2+)-dependent inactivation of the channel.
